attempts.text:
**The window starts on the anchor.** Column 0 is `mlaA`, a spine column carried by 100% of chromosomes, persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0.4% of calls; the model names it in 99% and hesitates 0.07 bits. Column 1 is a fork at `yfdF`, named in 60%, the second most hesitant column at 1.19 bits.

**Then a short spine, columns 2 to 6**, `fadL` to `sixA`, carried by 94%, persistent, in a region of plasticity in 4 to 23% of calls, named in 85 to 97%. The model's hesitation is low, most at `fadL`, 0.34 bits.

**The most plastic stretch follows**, columns 7 to 13, fork columns, in a region of plasticity in 68 to 96% of calls, named in 21 to 75%, most hesitant at column 8, 1.20 bits. A second branch of 4 families runs through columns 8 to 11, carried by 10 to 14%, all shell: a periplasmic chaperone and fimbrial proteins, [[fimbrial assembly]]. The model hesitates most here.

**A long spine runs from `smrB` to `ubiX`**, columns 14 to 34, carried by 90 to 94%, persistent, named in 85 to 99%. Then fork and variable columns 35 to 79, in a region of plasticity in 1 to 29% of calls, named in 66 to 99%; the variable stretch carries the `his` and `nuo` genes, [[histidine transport]] and [[NADH-quinone oxidoreduction]]. A second branch of 3 families, `yfbL` to `elaD`, runs through columns 74 to 76, carried by 36 to 49%, all shell.

**The window ends at `menC`**, column 79, carried by 41%. Inside a region of plasticity the model hesitates more than outside, 0.91 against 0.14 bits, and names fewer genes, 62% against 96%.

label: mlaA
facts:
WINDOW: the mlaA window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor mlaA, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 1,368 to 1,447 from dnaA. Read in 540 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying mlaA once); 43,200 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 91% of genes, 0.25 bits on average (perplexity 1.5 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 35,377 calls, named 97%, 0.10 bits; shell 7,390 calls, named 65%, 0.81 bits; cloud 433 calls, named 13%, 2.77 bits. Outside an RGP 36,782 calls, named 96%, 0.14 bits; inside an RGP 6,418 calls, named 62%, 0.91 bits. Columns: 27 spine, 15 fork, 38 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (0.91 against 0.14 bits) and names fewer genes (62% against 96%); 6,418 of the 43,200 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 8 (yfcU) 1.20 bits, RGP 95%; column 1 (yfdF) 1.19 bits, RGP 0.4%; column 70 (yfbM) 0.92 bits, RGP 25%. The 7 columns where most calls are in an RGP: named 58%, 0.51 bits on average; the other 73 columns: named 94%, 0.23 bits.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 7-13 (fork), RGP 68-96%; the least: column 0 (spine), RGP 0.4%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. column 0 spine: share 100%, all P, RGP 0.4%. Genes: mlaA. named 99%; 0.07 bits.
2. column 1 fork: RGP 0.4%. named 60%; 1.19 bits.
   1: yfdF S 42%; also yfdF (another family) S 29%
3. columns 2-6 (5 columns) spine: share 94%, all P, RGP 4-23%. Genes: fadL, yfcZ "YfcZ/YiiS family protein", fadI "acetyl-CoA C-acyltransferase FadI", fadJ, sixA. named 85-97% (mean 93%), fewest named at column 6 (sixA), named 85%; most hesitant at column 2 (fadL), 0.34 bits.
4. columns 7-13 (7 columns) fork: RGP 68-96%. named 21-75% (mean 58%), fewest named at column 10, named 21%; most hesitant at column 8, 1.20 bits.
   a second branch of 4 families through columns 8-11, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 10-14%, all S; the branch's families: "fimbria/pilus periplasmic chaperone", "fimbrial protein", "fimbrial protein", "fimbrial protein"
   7: yfcV S 64% "fimbrial protein"; also "fimbrial protein" S 12%
   8: yfcU S 81% "fimbria/pilus outer membrane usher…"
   9: yfcS S 79% "fimbria/pilus periplasmic chaperone"
   10: yfcR S 32% "fimbrial protein"; also "fimbrial protein" S 16%
   11: yfcQ S 52% "fimbrial protein"; also yfcQ (another family) S 14%
   12: yfcP S 50% "fimbrial protein"; also "fimbrial protein" S 12%
   13: yfcO S 30% "fimbrial adhesin YfcO"; also "StfH/YfcO family fimbrial adhesin" S 14%
5. columns 14-34 (21 columns) spine: share 90-94%, all P, RGP 1-15%. Genes: smrB, prmB, aroC, mepA, yfcA "TSUP family transporter", epmC, yfcL "YfcL family protein", mnmC, fabB, yfcJ "MFS transporter", flk, pdxB, usg, truA, dedA, accD, folC, dedD, cvpA, purF, ubiX. named 85-99% (mean 97%), fewest named at column 34 (ubiX), named 85%; most hesitant at column 14 (smrB), 0.29 bits.
6. columns 35-79 (45 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 1-29%. named 66-99% (mean 93%), fewest named at column 36, named 66%; most hesitant at column 70, 0.92 bits.
   a second branch of 3 families through columns 74-76, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 36-49%, all S; the branch's families: yfbL, yfbK, elaD
   columns 35-69 variable, share 77-90%, 34 P, 1 S: argT 89%, hisJ 89%, hisQ "histidine ABC transporter permease…" 89%, hisM 89%, hisP 89%, rpnB 77%, yfcH "TIGR01777 family oxidoreductase" 89%, folX 89%, yfcG "glutathione S-transferase N-termina…" 88%, yfcF "glutathione transferase" 89%, yfcE "metallophosphoesterase" 90%, yfcD "NUDIX hydrolase YfcD" 90%, yfcC "putative basic amino acid antiporte…" 89%, pta 89%, ackA 89%, yfbV "DUF412 family protein" 89%, yfbU "YfbU family protein" 89%, hxpA 89%, yfbS 89%, yfbR "YfbR-like 5'-deoxynucleotidase" 89%, alaA 89%, lrhA 88%, nuoA 89%, nuoB 89%, nuoC 89%, nuoE 89%, nuoF 89%, nuoG 89%, nuoH 88%, nuoI 88%, nuoJ "NADH-quinone oxidoreductase subunit…" 88%, nuoK 88%, nuoL 88%, nuoM 88%, nuoN 88%
   70 fork: yfbM P 83% "DUF1877 family protein"; also yfbP S 26%
   71 fork: yfbO S 26%; also "IS1-like element transposase" S 21%
   72 fork: rbn P 87%; also yfbN S 23%
   73 variable: elaA P 86%
